about_the_game:
NOTE: If using keyboard, all UI uses arrow keys, NOT mouse

Standard Game Mode - Single-Player

Ride your motorcycle along an infinite road, steering around obstacles in your way. Throw bombs at the demon towers along the road to destroy them and gain some time back for Earth's survival. Jump off ramps to leap over roadblocks. Use your shockwave ability to slam into the ground and destroy the next few rows of obstacles in your way!

Standard Game Mode - Two-Player

Local co-op two-player. Player 1 drives, player 2 leans, which helps (or hurts) player 1's ability to steer. Player 1 throws the bombs at the demon towers, player 2 detonates the bomb remotely at the right time to destroy the tower.  

Stuntdriver Game Mode

No demon towers, no bomb throwing, no timer. Be risky, jump off every ramp possible!

Character Customization

With the scores you rack up, visit your workshop to unlock new helmets and bike trails!

Leaderboards

Global and Friend leaderboards available for all 3 game modes!

Original Soundtrack

Includes 16 high-energy original tracks to ride along to!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (2020) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (quad-core, 2.3 GHz or higher) OR Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus 650 (integrated), AMD Radeon Pro 560 (2 GB VRAM), Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (6-core) OR Apple M1 Pro/M2
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5600M (4 GB VRAM) or better, Apple M1 Pro/M2 integrated GPU or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Ride and fly off ramps on your motorcycle in this arcade-style infinite runner. Demons take over the earth, you must fight to delay the inevitable! Brave the pandemonium as you chuck explosives and set off shockwaves. Ride tandem with a comrade for chaotic co-op.
